an10.85:1.1: LXXXV. Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahācundo Cetīsu viharati Sahajātiyaṃ. Tatra kho āyasmā Mahācundo bhikkhū āmantesi:-- Āvuso bhikkhavo ti. Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahācundassa paccassosuṃ. Āyasmā Mahācundo etad avoca:--
an10.85:2.1: Idhāvuso bhikkhu katthī hoti vikatthī adhigamesu ‘ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pī' ti.
an10.85:3.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo samanuyuñjati samanugāhati samanubhāsati. So Tathāgatena vā Tathāgatasāvakena vā jhāyinā samāpattikusalena paracittakusalena paracittapariyāyakusalena samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno iriṇaṃ āpajjati, vijinaṃ āpajjati, anayaṃ āpajjati, vyasanaṃ āpajjati, anayavyasanaṃ āpajjati.
an10.85:4.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaroti: Kin nu kho ayam āyasmā katthī hoti vikatthī adhigamesu ‘ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi . . . pe . . . ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pī' ti?
an10.85:5.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
an10.85:6.1: Dīgharattaṃ kho ayam āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī na santatakārī na santatavuttī sīlesu. Dussīlo ayam āyasmā, dussīlyaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:7.1: Assaddho kho panāyam āyasmā, assaddhiyaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:8.1: Appassuto kho pana ayam āyasmā anācāro, appasaccaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:9.1: Dubbaco kho panāyam āyasmā, dovacassatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:10.1: Pāpamitto kho panāyam āyasmā, pāpamittatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:11.1: Kusīto kho panāyam āyasmā, kosajjaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:12.1: Muṭṭhassati kho panāyam āyasmā, muṭṭhasaccaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:13.1: Kuhako kho panāyam āyasmā, kuhanā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:14.1: Dubbharo kho panāyam āyasmā, dubbharatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:15.1: Duppañño kho panāyam āyasmā, duppaññatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:16.1: Seyyathā pi āvuso sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya ‘yadā te samma dhanena dhanakaraṇīyaṃ assa, yācissasi maṃ dhanaṃ, dassāmi te dhanan' ti. So kismiñci-d-eva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya ‘attho me samma dhanena, dehi me dhanan' ti. So evaṃ vadeyya ‘tena hi samma idha khaṇāhī' ti. So tatra khaṇanto nādhigaccheyya. So evaṃ vadeyya ‘alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca: idha khaṇāhī' ti. So evaṃ vadeyya ‘nāhan taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, tena hi samma idha khaṇāhī' ti. So tatra pi khaṇanto nādhigaccheyya. So evaṃ vadeyya ‘alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca: idha khaṇāhī' ti. So evaṃ vadeyya ‘nāhan taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, tena hi samma idha khaṇāhī' ti. So tatra pi khaṇanto nādhigaccheyya. So evaṃ vadeyya ‘alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca: idha khaṇāhī' ti. So evaṃ vadeyya ‘nāhan taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, api ca aham eva ummādaṃ pāpuṇiṃ cetaso vipariyāyan' ti.
an10.85:17.1: Evam eva kho āvuso bhikkhu katthī hoti vikatthī adhigamesu ‘ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pī' ti.

an10.85:31.1: So vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme appahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī ti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. So vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme pahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatī ti.
